title: Pullman's conservatory filled with palms behind its great arch
items: Pullman's conservatory at 1800 Calumet Avenue is now planted behind its great arched glass front. Twenty more palms stand in rows across the house, rising toward the back, so the arch's lowest tier reads dark with fronds from side to side. The 1894 Inland Architect plate and Lowe's photograph both show it that way. Before, the far glass showed through between a few crowns.
Both pictures of the conservatory now match the model. The planting is a reconstruction, because no picture of the inside is known.
